Reviewed the dashboard and commitment. Short answer: swap is operationally feasible for a temporary window if capacity is available in the region. Financial ask (reduced overage cap) is where Deal Desk needs exec sign-off. Proposed internal terms to present to the customer:

- Temporary H100 substitution for up to 40% of committed vGPU units for a 6-week period (2026-08-03 -> 2026-09-13).
- Overage: reduce standard overage rate by 30% for usage attributable to the temporary window, capped at a $25k total overage credit for the period.
- Reservation hold: prevent auto-downscale or reallocation for the committed units during the window; this requires a reservation hold flag and a one-time administrative fee (we can rebate the fee if customer signs amendment).

I'll need an exec approval for the overage cap and to approve the rebate language. If we get an OK, Legal wants the redlined SOW (attached) and a DocuSign amendment.

Subject: APPROVED: Temporary H100 substitution + capped overage — conditional

Caleb / team —

We've reviewed LumenEdge's request and will approve the temporary H100 substitution and reduced overage cap with the following conditions:

1) Swap: Up to 40% of your committed Dedicated capacity may run on H100s from 2026-08-03 through 2026-09-13.
2) Overage: We will apply a 30% reduction to standard overage rates for usage during the window, capped at $25,000 total. Any overage beyond the cap reverts to standard rates.
3) Reservation hold: We will apply a reservation hold flag to prevent auto-downscale for the committed units for the window. We will waive the administrative hold fee if the customer signs the attached amendment in DocuSign within 72 hours of this email.
4) Supply and margin: approval contingent on the amendment being signed and an acknowledgement from the customer that usage is subject to capacity availability; retroactive credit will not be issued for backdated usage prior to signed amendment.

Action items for LumenEdge: please sign the amendment sent via DocuSign here: https://www.docusign.net/MLink?R=1234-LE-AMEND within 72 hours so we can schedule the swap. Once signed, Ops will schedule the H100 mapping and confirm the reservation hold.

Thanks — we'll stand up the amendment and route for signature now.

— Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
